name: Raon-1 mini model card
notes:
Fetched 2026-11-25. KRAFTON Raon-1 mini card (repo created 2026-11-24T13:17Z, last modified 2026-11-25T06:12Z). Apache-2.0. Card nameplate: 30B-A4B, total 28.8B / activated 4.3B, 25 layers, hidden 2,560, hybrid attention RDA 3:1 Gated MLA (18 RDA + 7 MLA layers), NoPE, 128 routed experts + 6 routed/1 shared per token, expert intermediate 1,088, first layer dense FFN 12,032, SiTU-GLU, Raon-mHC with 4 residual streams, vocab 259,840 untied, 262,144 native context, checkpoint MXFP8 (quantization_config quant_method mxfp8). Card also ships NVFP4, which it says fits a single RTX 5090 (32 GB).

BENCHMARK TABLE SHAPE: one printed table with 8 model columns: Raon-1 mini (30B-A4B), Raon-1 mini preview, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Gemma 4 26B-A4B, Flint (40B-A2.5B), Inkling 2 Mini (26.4B-A5.4B), Qwen3.8-27B, Muse Glimmer 30B. Red highlight = best within the MoE group only (the card says so); the last two columns are dense reference models. Judge and user simulator gpt-5.6-luna. Per-benchmark reasoning effort and presence_penalty (0 for coding/math, 1.5 elsewhere), temp 1.0 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20. Footnotes: SWE-Verified uses mini-SWE-agent; GDPVal is a judge score not Elo; AutomationBench is the public split; AA-LCR-adjacent GDP.pdf is the Artificial Analysis text-only version; Chatbot Korean is an internal, unreleased benchmark.
